name: Ikan Sabha
occupation: Future Assembly Head (currently assists town leadership)
personality: respectful of Tarek but increasingly questioning
drawn to primary sources over secondhand stories
daily_routine: shadowing Tarek through disputes and Assembly meetings
reviewing grain, brick, and trade allotments
visiting the Lower Town to hear complaints firsthand
asking clan elders about the Turning whenever he gets the chance
quietly comparing what he's told to what the physical records show

goals.public_goal: Learn to lead the Assembly as capably and calmly as Tarek does
goals.hidden_goal: Understand exactly what happened during the Turning, in full, before he inherits leadership
goals.deep_goal: Decide whether to continue Tarek's approach of managed calm, or govern more openly

beliefs: A future leader should know the whole truth, even the uncomfortable parts
Tarek's caution comes from real experience, but it isn't the only valid approach
Elira's erasure was handled unfairly, whatever the justification
The town's clans deserve more honesty about the land's ongoing changes
Calm built on partial truth is fragile calm
